contact-sqm-ricardo-ramos.whyThisPerson: Ricardo Ramos holds Gerente General, which makes them accountable for exactly the exposure this removes.
contact-sqm-ricardo-ramos.angle: Contracted inspection crews are the cost and the risk; autonomous coverage removes the exposure without reducing the inspection frequency.

facts.text: SQM's own 20-F for period ending 2026-04-22 names contractor safety incidents and contractor work stoppages as risks to production, referring to contractors 15 times

proofPoint.claim: Automated PV inspection with thermal anomaly detection across large arrays

contact-sqm-ricardo-ramos.ask: Offer to send a short written breakdown of how the reference customer changed inspection cadence. Ask only for permission to send it — never for a meeting, and never propose a time.
withheld: Ley 20.571 / SEC technical norms is the instrument that forces inspection cadence here, but its text was not fetched in this run, so it is withheld from the copy. A wrong decree number is worse than none.
Deployment sizing rests on stated engineering assumptions, so its figures are kept out of a first touch and reserved for the discovery call.
